description: Propose a code change to a ce repo you may read: the files are committed through the cell version control (src.commit) to your own branch contrib/<account>/<id>, never main. A ce operator reviews it; a merge lands it on main and counts as verified work for your trust (trust_show). Limits: 50 files, 512 KiB, 10 proposals a day; no .github/, .cargo/, build.rs, scripts, keys or secrets. Needs a signed-in connection whose account holds contribute access (source.write).

base.description: optional: the commit you based the change on (source_repos head); default the current main

content.description: the whole new text of the file; null deletes it

message.description: what the change does and why (the commit message)

name: source_propose
title: Propose a change to ce source
